title: Icons to payment confirmation

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Use continuity of shape to explain a change of state because viewers need to understand what happened to an action.
strategic_value: A circle becoming a button and then a check can connect Wise’s brand geometry to functional feedback.
demonstration: The animation moves from arrow icons to rotating currency symbols, a pill-shaped Pay now control and a final check inside a green circle.
practical_value: Compare how one geometric container can bridge an action and its confirmation.

content_islands.name: Icon states
content_islands.spec: Present directional and currency symbols in circular frames.

content_islands.name: Action state
content_islands.spec: Extend the frame into a wide rounded payment control.

content_islands.name: Confirmation
content_islands.spec: Contract to a circle and draw the check.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation moves from arrow icons to rotating currency symbols, a pill-shaped Pay now control and a final check inside a green circle.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates a geometric transition from payment action to confirmation.

ingredient.name: Circle-to-pill transition
ingredient.role: Connect the action state with its confirmation.
ingredient.application: Expand the circle into a rounded payment control, then return to a circle carrying a check in this sequence.
ingredient.scope: Observed animation; no easing curve, timing contract or general interaction requirement is stated.
